- Laura: Legal redline on the PR + publicity clause (urgent).

Markus — quick note:

Were flexible on co-marketing discounts for PR-led deals but deal desk policy puts a 15% cap for AE approvals. Anything >15% requires a Director-level sign-off. Given the strategic name (Veridian) and timing, I recommend approving a one-year, one-time 20% discount as a standard ask when were getting a joint PR + case study — but only if Veridian signs a 12-month co-marketing commitment (email list promotion + webinar slot) and we get final approval on PR text.

If Legal pushes back on wording, suggest we consider an alternative concession: keep pricing at 15% plus a $10k professional services credit for joint content production. That keeps ledger impact lower but still gives perceived commercial value to Veridian.

Happy to prep a short approval memo for Jonas.

-Marissa
Head of Sales Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft press release & co-marketing ask (Veridian + Redwood)

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed Veridians draft PR and have two major legal concerns:

1) Broad publicity grant: the draft currently grants unlimited rights to use Redwoods marks and a perpetual license to reproduce our materials. We need to limit this to:
   - a single press release and one follow-up case study asset,
   - logo usage limited to the PR and co-branded landing page, and
   - Redis approval of final PR text and quote prior to publication.

2) Exclusivity and implied endorsements: the draft contains language that may imply an endorsement beyond factual partnership. We should remove any exclusivity request and add a short disclaimer that Redwoods inclusion does not constitute a product endorsement beyond the described integration.

Ive attached a redlined PR (PR_redline_v1.docx) with suggested edits. Legal can also prepare a short publicity addendum to the MSA that covers scope (term limited to 12 months), approval process, and misuse remedies.

If Sales wants to proceed with a 20%+ concession, Legal will require the publicity language to be narrowed as above and that marketing sign-off occurs before discount is granted / contract executed.

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: PR_redline_v1.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft press release & co-marketing ask (Veridian + Redwood)

Team — after reviewing the ask and the naming value, I approve a one-time, first-year 22% discount for RDW-DEAL-2487 with these firm conditions:
- Marketing must approve the final PR and quote within 48 hours of the redline being returned.
- Legal must incorporate the publicity addendum limiting logo use, duration (12 months), and removing any exclusivity or implied endorsement language.
- The discount is applied to committed usage for year 1 only; renewal at standard T&C.
- If Legal or Marketing cannot sign off on the PR scope, swap the commercial concession: 15% discount + $10k professional services credit for co-marketing support.

Marissa — please document the approval in Deal Desk (HubSpot note + approval memo). Markus — you have permission to tell Veridian we can proceed under these terms and will send the signed amendment after Legal finalizes the addendum.

-Jonas
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the draft and for putting this together. Good news: Redwood can participate under the following conditions (approved by Sales leadership and Legal):

1) Commercial: Redwood will offer a one-time 22% discount on committed usage for year 1 for RDW-DEAL-2487, contingent on Legal-approved publicity language. If Legal/Marketing cannot sign off on the requested scope, we will instead offer 15% + $10,000 professional services credit.

2) Publicity scope: logo use and a quote are permitted for the PR and a single follow-up case study page, limited to 12 months. Redwood must approve final PR text and any quote prior to publication. No exclusivity and no implied endorsement beyond the described integration.

3) Next steps:
- Ive attached Legals redline (PR_redline_v1.docx). Please incorporate or respond to the edits.
- Marketing will review and aim to sign off within 48 hours.
- Legal will prepare a short publicity addendum to the MSA and a DocuSign link for the amendment (see HubSpot deal/2487).

If youre aligned, please confirm acceptance of the conditions and well proceed with the logistics for the June 2 timeline.

Thanks — Mark
